description: Historic Flood Extents 2011 is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ipswich City Council. This dataset represents the maximum innundation line of the January 2011 Bremer River floods as captured by the Ipswich City Council. The line is based on surveyed levels captured after the event from debri lines. Coverage: Ipswich City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Ipswich City Council. Its tags are 2011, Flood, Historic Flood, Ipswich City. It offers 6 resource(s) in geojson, kml, shp, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
